 Between Steps Episode 11 Preview: Release Date, Time & Where To Watch
 9 November 2026 by Greg Wheeler 
 Between Steps
 Between Steps is a romantic K-drama set against the unusual backdrop of a university robotics lab, following two young people who find themselves taking very different paths through life.
 Park Min-jae was once a promising swimmer, but his dreams were shattered when an illness resulted in him losing his right leg. Forced to leave competitive swimming behind, Min-jae eventually finds a new purpose in robotics and is now studying as a PhD student.
 Im Yoo-jin, meanwhile, studied fashion but finds herself struggling to work out what she wants from her future. After circumstances derail her original plans, meeting Min-jae opens her eyes to an entirely different world and eventually leads her towards robotics.
 As the pair begin spending more time together in the same research lab, Yoo-jin’s straightforward personality starts breaking through Min-jae’s emotional barriers. What follows is a bittersweet romance about two people finding a new direction in both their careers and their personal lives.
 If you’ve been looking forward to this K-drama, you may be curious to find out when the episodes are releasing. Well, wonder no more!
 Here is everything you need to know about episode 11 of Between Steps, including the release date, time and where you can watch this show.
 Where Can I Watch Between Steps? 
 Between Steps will be shown on ENA for those watching in Korea, with episodes airing every Monday and Tuesday at 10pm (KST). The drama is also available internationally on Disney+, including in the UK.
 Between Steps Episode 11 Release Date 
 Episode 11 of Between Steps will release on Monday 9th November at approximately 1pm (GMT) / 9am (ET).
 Subtitles should be available from release, although depending on your region, there may occasionally be a slight delay between the Korean broadcast and the episode appearing on Disney+.
 How Many Episodes Will Between Steps Have? 
 Between Steps is scheduled to drop with 12 episodes in total. With 2 episodes dropping every week on Monday and Tuesday, the drama should run through until the middle of November. With that in mind, after this episode there will be 1 more to go!
